integrity: A complete 11-case exact permutation classification is supplied with independent geometric enumeration and standalone verification code; no independent external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: This is a finite-etale Frobenius classification of two Kummer tetrad parameter schemes, not a classification of curves or their Jacobian Weil polynomials. One branch-type collision persists over all extensions. General existence of every branch partition over each fixed odd finite field is not asserted. Mathematical priority and the proof have not received independent audit.
title: Göpel and Rosenhain tetrad counts determine their joint zeta functions over finite fields
